scope: db/v2 schema objects (58 tables) + DB functions/triggers + storage policies + isolation/functional test rigs + grant posture. Convention: PORT = take largely as-is (many carry a 'hardening note' for additive, trivially-in-place fixes like a missing RBAC floor that do NOT rise to a wrong-implementation rebuild); REBUILD = right idea, wrong implementation, rebuild to the named standard; DROP = do not carry forward.
